summary.en: A native screenshot, annotation and pinning app with offline OCR.
summary.zh-CN: 原生截图、标注与贴图工具，内置离线文字识别。

description.en: Capture a region, annotate it, pin it above other windows, or recognize text locally. Scrolling screenshots are available on Windows and Linux; region recording and GIF export are included in the latest source preview.
description.zh-CN: 框选截图、标注并置顶贴图，或在本机识别文字。Windows/Linux 支持滚动长截图；最新源码预览还包含区域录屏与 GIF 导出。
